title: Sunflag Iron & Steel - LIVE deep dive #1 (random draw, protocol v1.3 stages 2-7): method test, no verdict; card rule output size 0; 6 live calls
body: LIVE method test (L9, L21): company drawn at random to measure whether the deep-dive method has forecasting skill; no buy/sell verdict. Research, not advice. SELECTION: universe.csv 1,547 -> 810 in Rs 1,000-20,000 cr (NSE close 20-Nov-2026) -> 741 after removing 69 financials -> random.Random(20261123).shuffle. Walk: NRBBEARING skipped (PEAD Q2 SUE -0.09 quintile 2, event 04-Nov-2026); VSTIND skipped (SUE -1.30 quintile 1 after adding the missing Q2 FY26 EPS and bonus-adjusting); HINDWAREAP skipped by a judgment scoreability rule (NCLT-sanctioned composite scheme dissolves the listed entity; deviation flagged); SUNFLAG = subject. S2: all hard rules pass (unmodified audits FY25/FY26, auditor rotation after a 5-year term, CRISIL AA-/Stable, tiny RPTs); no promoter encumbrance (SHP XBRL; NSE pledge API returned 0 rows for all symbols on 23-Nov-2026); solvency 0 flags; PEAD quintile 4. KEY FINDING: Sunflag holds 6.00 cr Lloyds Metals & Energy shares (10.66%, from a 2022 arbitral award) worth Rs 10,343 cr pre-tax / ~Rs 9,016 cr post-tax vs a Rs 6,643 cr market cap (156% / 136%). At our steel DCF (Rs 93/123/170 per share) the market applies a 45/52/61% discount to the post-tax stake - inside the Indian holdco range, so no claimable mispricing. Reasons verified: no monetisation/payout policy, 74 lakh LMEL shares pledged to Indian Bank, a 10-asset mining programme with weak delivery (0 of 5 milestones on pace; Belgaon reserve figure stale then cut 5.39 -> 3.5 MT), no earnings calls (~1% institutions). Steel business: 467.5k t rolled FY26, Rs 84.3k/t revenue, ~Rs 10.2k/t EBITDA, OPM 12.1%; carbon basket 24% of sales (+/-240 bp per 10%), power 6.9% (Rs 5.8/kWh; renewable share 10% -> 30%), minimum wage not a driver (10 bp per 10% step); operating ROCE ~14% pre-tax (~CoE after tax), net debt Rs 26 cr Sep-2026. VALUATION (worksheet v1.2): base IRR 11.7% vs CoE 12.5%; stub (55% discount) = 5.4x EV/EBITDA, 12.5x P/E (KSL 12.6x); price needs NOPAT margin 8.2% vs 6.9% (growth irrelevant at ROIIC ~ CoE); 5-yr EV 1.38x vs hurdle 1.76x; P(>=3x) 6% vs base 44%. CARD: size 0 (EV below hurdle); 6 open soft flags with a written variant view; review 2027-02-15. CALLS (live, to 2027-09-30): FY27 revenue >= 4,300 cr 0.63 (base 0.42); FY27 OPM >= 11.0% 0.68 (0.58); FY27 PAT >= 240 cr 0.65 (0.55); Bajna EC by Sep-2027 0.35 (0.50); LMEL stake reduced 0.08 (0.15); beats Nifty 500 0.46 (0.44); plus card 5-yr calls. METHOD LESSONS: (1) selection needs a scoreability rule (schemes that dissolve the entity); (2) promise tracker needs an AR-status mode for companies without calls; (3) worksheet gained non_operating_growth so holdco-like stocks get a correct 5-yr multiple (regression-checked); (4) stub analysis + implied-discount range beats trailing P/E when a stake exceeds the market cap; (5) NSE pledge API can return 0 rows for all symbols - use SHP XBRL encumbrance flags.

title: Variant view (live #1): Sunflag's ~50% discount on its LMEL stake is justified and persists absent a distribution event; the steel business is safe, the risk is LMEL
body: Method-test variant-perception record (not a recommendation). MARKET PRICES: Sunflag as a discounted LMEL proxy - at our steel DCF the post-tax stake carries a 45-61% (central 52%) discount; equivalently, at a 55% discount steel trades at 5.4x EV/EBITDA, 12.5x P/E. OUR VIEW: no claimable mispricing; the discount is explained by no monetisation/payout policy, collateral use of the stake (74 lakh shares pledged), a mining programme with weak delivery, and no investor communication; underweighted by the market: near-zero net debt, AA- rating, ~14% pre-tax operating ROCE. PROVES US WRONG: (a) LMEL sale + buyback/special dividend (gap closes); (b) stake proceeds or new debt into mining, borrowings > Rs 1,000 cr (discount widens); (c) FY27 OPM < 9%. SCORED BY: thesis:paper-call:SUNFLAG:fy27-revenue-4300cr-plus, fy27-opm-11pct-plus, fy27-net-profit-240cr-plus, bajna-ec-granted-by-sep27, lmel-stake-reduced-by-sep27, beats-nifty500-to-sep27, and the card's 5-year calls. Market-cap/stake ratio on 20-Nov-2026: 0.64 (3-yr range 0.46-1.12).

title: Decision card SUNFLAG 2026-11-23 (paper)
body: Decision card v1 for Sunflag Iron & Steel. Rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.38x vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Thesis: Method-test thesis: about three quarters of Sunflag's value is a 10.66% stake in Lloyds Metals & Energy (post-tax ~Rs 9,016 cr vs a Rs 6,643 cr market cap); the special-steel business compounds ~8%/yr at ~7% NOPAT margin with ROIIC close to the cost of equity, and the market's ~50% discount on the stake persists over 5 years unless the stake is monetised and distributed. Variant view: Market (reverse DCF): at Rs 368.60 the price implies either a 45-61% discount on the post-tax LMEL stake (if the steel business is worth our bear-to-bull DCF of Rs 93-170/share) or, at a 55% discount, 5.4x EV/EBITDA and 12.5x P/E for steel (KSL 12.6x). Our view: the gap is NOT a mispricing we can claim. The discount sits inside the Indian holdco base range (insight:group-holdco-discount) and is justified by three things we verified: no stated monetisation or payout policy (dividend Re 1, ~9% payout), the stake already serves as loan collateral (74 lakh LMEL shares pledged to Indian Bank), and management is spending on a 10-block mining programme with a weak delivery record (Lohardongri LOI 2019, still not operating; Belgaon reserve figure stale for a year). What we add that the market may underweight: the steel balance sheet is now near debt-free (net debt Rs 26 cr at Sep-2026, CRISIL AA-/Stable) and the business earns a ~14% pre-tax ROCE, so the bear case is LMEL-driven, not steel-driven. What would prove us wrong: (a) a board decision to sell LMEL shares with a buyback/special dividend (gap closes; our 'persists' call fails), or (b) LMEL proceeds or new debt going into mining capex (discount widens; our steel-is-safe view fails). Departure from the outside view (card §5): our P(>=3x in 5y) is far below the base class and P(<=0.5x) above it on purpose. The class is survivors of the 2020-25 small-cap bull run (x3 overstated, losses understated, per its caveats); Sunflag's 5-year outcome is ~75% a single listed stock (LMEL, already up ~3.2x in 3 years) held at a discount, plus a steel business whose ROIIC is close to the cost of equity, so a 3x needs LMEL to roughly triple again or the discount to close; the fatter left tail is single-stock concentration (beta 0.73 to LMEL). These 5-year card calls are the cleanest test in this file of whether our structural adjustment beats the naive class. Checked by paper calls thesis:paper-call:SUNFLAG:* (6 operating/event/price calls to 2027-09-30, plus the 3 card calls). Open soft flags: 6. P(≥3x) 6% vs base 44%; P(≤0.5x) 8% vs base 2.0%; EV 5-yr multiple 1.38x vs hurdle 1.76x. Review 2027-02-15.
